svg.title: Wooden 12 V bench — individual control wiring

g.text: 15 physical positions on the removable deck • rear at top • supplier photos identify parts • signal-side view
Reserve for the fused power harness, level shifters, LCD, accelerometer and lighting.
Each blue trace is one switch signal. Dots mark a junction. Orange dashed leads are capped at the breakout end.
Momentary switches: 3V3 → COM, NO → blue GPIO trace. For the two-tab Sanwa, either tab can be the supply.
Drain: GPIO1 → common. BALL HELD throw → GND. EMPTY throw → insulated, open. Boot in EMPTY with AUTO idle.
Park left flipper (GPIO37 / R8 PSRAM) and Pop 3 (GPIO48 / onboard RGB). Breakout terminal order is schematic.
Photos: Freenove, Arcade Parts UK, RS, Hobby Components and APEM. APEM supplies a generic 5000-series image for 5236ADKB.
The orange OBSF-24 photo identifies all seven arcade buttons. Dry-fit the full layout on cardboard before cutting. Photo sizes are illustrative.
